notes.title: The Flightless Fables Kickstarter Is Off To A Great Start!
notes.notes: [p]The [i][b]Flightless Fables[/b][/i] Kickstarter is off to great start thanks to a lot of wonderful backers! The [i]Super Fan[/i] reward tier (where you get to design an in-game weapon) is almost scooped up, so if you'd like to show your support for the project, come check out the Kickstarter page:[/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/klardonics/flightless-fables-adorable-dungeon-crawling-platformer" style="button"]Join The Campaign![/url][/p][p][/p][p]Of course, if you simply want to share the campaign and spread the word, that's greatly appreciated as well! Thanks a bunch, and happy dungeon crawling![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503574/1f0e3dab1e819389fc412de8c15042943323efe5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Flightless Fables is coming to Kickstarter!
notes.notes: [p]For those of you interested, [b]Flightless Fables is coming to Kickstarter July 29th[/b]! The goal is to accelerate the game's development and cover the costs of a soundtrack composer.[/p][p][/p][p]You can find the prelaunch page here: [b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/klardonics/flightless-fables-adorable-dungeon-crawling-platformer"]Kickstarter Page[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for following the project so far! Hopefully some major milestones will be met in the near future![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503574/0673f93926c1226b2a4975d0821b0981871357b2.gif"][/img][/p]
